# PFW-006: IPv6 is covered by the provider or the host firewall

- **Group:** Provider firewall
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

A Hetzner Cloud Firewall filters IPv4 and IPv6 with one rule list. The OVH Edge Network Firewall filters IPv4 only, so a host with a global IPv6 address is open on IPv6 as far as it goes, and the host firewall is the only layer there. This check fails when the host has a global IPv6 address that neither the provider nor a host firewall filters.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ip -6 addr show scope global; and the host firewall's IPv6 rules (ufw status verbose shows (v6) rules)
```

## How to fix it

Keep a host firewall that denies incoming IPv6 by default (UFW with IPV6=yes), or remove the global IPv6 address if nothing uses it

## What a fix can break

Removing the IPv6 address breaks clients that reach the host over IPv6 only.
